claim: Result Envelope is free and MIT licensed.
where: landing facts, terms, package metadata, and README
test: npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:free-license'
sandbox: fresh clone; inspect package metadata and LICENSE

claim: The versioned npm tarball installs in a clean project and exposes the library and CLI.
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:installable-package'
sandbox: fresh temporary npm project; install the generated release tarball; import the API and run the installed CLI

claim: The one-click demo loads 12 realistic orders, builds their envelope, and resets to the original sample.
where: landing first action, demo banner, and demo documentation
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:demo-sample'
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; replace input; reset; assert 12 bundled orders and a built envelope

claim: The browser inspector processes JSON in the current tab and uploads none of the input.
where: landing facts, inspector, privacy, and README
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:local-processing'
sandbox: fresh browser context; edit demo data; capture the complete request log

claim: The real inspector saves no input in cookies, local storage, session storage, or a server.
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:browser-no-storage'
sandbox: fresh browser context at /inspect; build private input; inspect browser storage; reload

claim: The site loads no analytics, advertising, tracking scripts, or third-party fonts.
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:site-no-tracking'
sandbox: fresh browser context; capture requests across landing and privacy; inspect script and font elements

claim: JSON types, source details, and row order stay intact.
test: npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:json-types'
sandbox: typed fixture containing numbers, booleans, nulls, arrays, nested objects, and provenance

claim: createEnvelope returns a manifest, compact summary, schema, and first stable page with documented metadata.
where: landing guide and README API description
test: npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:api-shape'
sandbox: 12-row typed fixture; assert identity, every cap/count, page-count text, provenance, numeric range, nullable and non-nullable fields, and first page

claim: The browser inspector shows four populated envelope parts: manifest, summary, schema, and page.
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:inspector-parts'
sandbox: fresh query demo; open each output tab and assert visible populated output

claim: The sample envelope shows caps, field types, counts, and its next cursor.
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:envelope-details'
sandbox: fresh query demo; inspect manifest, schema, metrics, and first page output

claim: The compact summary contains counts and numeric ranges, not sample rows.
test: npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:summary-no-rows'
sandbox: fixture with a unique row value; assert that serialized summary output omits it

claim: Each page respects the configured row and byte caps.
test: npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:page-caps'
sandbox: 12-row fixture; assert every serialized page against both configured caps

claim: maxRows stops the included row count and marks the manifest as capped.
test: npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:row-cap'
sandbox: 12-row fixture with maxRows four; assert total, included, and capped fields

claim: A row that cannot fit the byte cap fails with ROW_TOO_LARGE guidance.
test: npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:row-too-large'
sandbox: one oversized row with the minimum byte cap; assert the typed error and row guidance

claim: Inputs must be JSON values with finite numbers and no circular references.
test: npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:input-validation'
sandbox: fixtures containing NaN and a circular reference; assert INVALID_INPUT errors

claim: The same input and caps produce the same cursor; changed data rejects it with INVALID_CURSOR.
test: npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:stable-cursors'
sandbox: clone the same fixture; compare cursors; assert INVALID_CURSOR after changing rows

claim: streamEnvelope returns an async iterator that yields the documented library chunks.
test: npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:stream-api'
sandbox: 12-row typed fixture; assert Symbol.asyncIterator identity and observable manifest-to-pages iteration

claim: Stream chunks arrive as manifest, summary, schema, then bounded pages.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:stream-order'
sandbox: pipe a two-row NDJSON fixture into the documented pack - --format ndjson --stream command; assert ordered chunks

claim: The package makes no network, model, or telemetry calls.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:package-no-network'
sandbox: spy on global fetch while packing and paging; inspect built artifacts for network clients or model endpoints

claim: The library has no runtime dependencies.
test: npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:zero-runtime-dependencies'
sandbox: fresh clone; inspect package metadata dependencies

claim: The package metadata requires Node.js 18 or newer.
test: npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:node-support'
sandbox: fresh clone; assert the exact package engines range

claim: The CLI demo writes a complete sample envelope to a new temporary directory.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:cli-demo'
sandbox: fresh temporary directory; run the bundled demo and inspect its output file

claim: result-envelope --help lists every supported command and flag.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:cli-help'
sandbox: fresh built CLI; compare help commands and flags with the parser surface; exercise help, version, and unknown-command paths

claim: The CLI writes JSON to stdout and actionable errors to stderr with a non-zero exit code.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:cli-io'
sandbox: pipe valid and invalid JSON into the documented CLI; assert output streams and exit codes

claim: The demo reopens offline after its first visit.
where: landing first-screen facts, README, and demo documentation
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:offline-reload'
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; wait for the service worker; reload offline

claim: Demo edits stay in the tab and are discarded when demo mode ends.
where: demo banner, inspector, README, and demo documentation
test: npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:demo-memory'
sandbox: fresh browser context; edit sample; leave demo; inspect storage; reopen demo

claim: npm run build creates the library, routed static site, and versioned npm tarball in dist.
test: npm run build && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern '@claim:build-output'
sandbox: fresh clone; run the production build; assert library, route HTML, 404, and tarball files
